UK · France · Belgium · Netherlands · Germany · Switzerland · Italy · Vatican
by Hare Krishna Golden Temple · London & Europe Yatra

Travel with Hare Krishna devotees through eight countries in sixteen days. Take darshan at ten ISKCON temples, beginning with Srila Prabhupada's Bhaktivedanta Manor and the castle temple of Radhadesh, and see Europe's great sights, from the Tower of London and the Eiffel Tower to the snows of Mount Titlis, Venice and the Vatican. Flights, visas, hotels, meals and sightseeing are all included.

Punya Kshetras is the pilgrimage service of Hare Krishna Golden Temple, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Every yatra is led by devotees, with kirtan, japa and the glories of each holy place narrated along the way, sattvic food, careful planning and special attention to elders.
His Divine Grace A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Srila Prabhupada,

The holy places all over the earth are meant for purifying the polluted consciousness of the human being by an atmosphere surcharged with the presence of the Lord's unalloyed devotees. If anyone visits a holy place, he must search out the pure devotees residing in such holy places, take lessons from them, try to apply such instructions in practical life and thus gradually prepare oneself for moksha.
Late April is spring: tulips at their peak, long evenings, 15–21 °C by day and 6–11 °C at night. Mount Titlis is below zero, so carry a warm jacket and gloves.

The Hyderabad group flies Emirates via Dubai and lands at Heathrow at 4:10 pm; the Bangalore group flies Etihad via Abu Dhabi and lands at 6:45 pm.
